d:
Bina Eno, bina fermentation ke bazaar se behtar crispy Jalebi ghar par
Poonam Devnani ki no-fail Jalebi + Rabri, shuddh ghee mein. Dussehra ke liye perfect, aur khas kadhai na ho toh moti thali mein bhi ban jayegi!
bina ino, bina pharment krispi jalebi
shuddh ghi men, baitar men kalar nahin
moti thali ya appe mold men banaen
baitar 2 din phrij men rakhen
dahi dalkar aasan rabri
Comment karein: Aap Jalebi kiske saath khate hain: rabri, dahi ya doodh? Aur Dussehra par aap kya bana rahe hain?
